newsitem.title: USA: NBTY says in talks with Holland & Barrett.
newsitem.headline: NBTY says in talks with Holland & Barrett.

text.p: NBTY said Monday that it is in talks with British vitamin maker, Holland & Barrett, about a possible purchase of the company. NBTY, a U.S. based vitamin maker, said in a statement that while negotiations are ongoing, no definitive purchase agreement has been reached.
NBTY said that in the case of a successful agreement, it would finance the purchase through the issuance of long-term debt.

Scott Rudolph, the chairman and chief executive officer of NBTY said, "Presently we operate 100 stores in the U.S. and this acquisition would be part of our strategic plan to expand our retail division. The acquisition would make us the largest vitamin retailer in the U.K."
